invariants.name: Zero Committed Secrets
invariants.description: No API keys, database passwords, or auth tokens may ever be written to source code or git. All secrets must resolve via process.env.

invariants.name: Safe Non-Destructive Storage
invariants.description: No unconfirmed DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE or schema-destroying commands on production DB.

invariants.name: Scraper Rate Limiting & Stealth
invariants.description: All retailer scrapes must obey store-grouped rate limiting (minimum 2000ms delay) to avoid IP bans.

invariants.name: Hydration Safety in Client Components
invariants.description: Time-dependent values like Date.now() must be rendered in useEffect or dedicated hydration-safe wrappers.

invariants.name: Deterministic Verification Chain
invariants.description: No commit may be pushed to main without clean exit code 0 from verify-gate.
